scenario.summary: On the keyword search results left open by verifyProductBoosted, verifies the buried product is listed last (name and SKU).
steps: Verify the last listed product's name and SKU
assertions: Last listed product is the buried product
evidence: DECLARED ACCOUNT (per method): verifyWishListFunctionalityForRetailUser signs in with loginPage.customerSuccessfullLogin(testClassRetailUsers/productListingPageTest Username, Password; loginAndRegistration!B179/C179) and the later methods of the class (priority 100-125) run in that signed-in session until productListingPageLoggOffTheUser. Convention: every method that signs in or reuses the signed-in session declares user = USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED {store}, preferred {source: the username source, required: true} (Tda.declareUser -> useExisting). Username/password stay credential sources (masked); the scanner recorded them only on the sign-in method, later methods declare the same two cells from the test source (the session they reuse).

Reuses the search results of verifyProductBoosted (no dependsOn, priority order). First method captures: bury is declared by verifyProductBoosted with keyword @boost.keyword (class field); this method declares only the account. Runs in the signed-in session of verifyWishListFunctionalityForRetailUser (declares the account, see DECLARED ACCOUNT).
Sheet values BuriedProductNameInAdmin / BuriedProductSku are data of that bury record (bury.productName / productSku).

HEAD RECORD VALUES (first method captures): boostAndBury/BuriedProductNameInAdmin/Input -> bury.productName; boostAndBury/BuriedProductSku/Input -> bury.productSku. These values belong to a record the head method declares (as data with that output there); this method has no needs, so they are recorded as expected-output copies (chain rule confirmed by the user 2026-11-10). The migrated method reads them from the class field (alias.output above), not from the sheet; after migration and rescan they leave this entry.
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-10) where cited.
